name: @webdesk/dashboard-worker
description: Serverless-handler foundation for asynchronous/scheduled work. NEVER a permanent process (WDS-005, ADR-0004) — every job type is a separate stateless handler triggered by a queue message, workflow step, or cron invocation. Phase 1A ships the handler contract and a health/status handler only — no real Vercel Queues/Workflows/Cron/Redis/PostgreSQL connection yet.
